messages:
Marcel: Heads up — Zenith Health just asked for an exec-level unblock. POC is green on model quality but stuck on infra/security questions and pricing. They want a commitment decision by EOD Fri. Can we triage?
Aisha: Noted. Where exactly is it blocked? I heard security questionnaire + dedicated VPC network requirement.
Marcel: Correct. Two blockers: 1) legal/security require a specialist to sign off on our SOC / data handling answers (they sent a 30-page questionnaire). 2) Networking: their infra team says our VPC peering approach needs a private subnet deployment — they want on-prem-like isolation.
Raj: From eng side — the POC instance is on Dedicated-1 (shared infra). We can spin a private VPC in the next 48 hours but need a config template for their network team (allowed CIDR, egress rules, firewall ports).
Priya: I pulled their questionnaire. A few answers need product/eng confirmation: data retention, key management (they require HSM/KMS control), and logs retention. I can draft responses but will need Raj to confirm the technical details for KMS integration.
Seth: Pricing note: the current POC credits don’t cover a private Dedicated cluster. If we move to Dedicated VPC for the POC we should quote a short-term uplift + an enterprise commit. What tier are we proposing?
Marcel: They asked for a 6-month convert-to-commit pathway. Sales prefers a 3mo POC then annual reserved commit. Need a fast price sketch to present to their CTO/Procurement. Aisha, can you do a ballpark by tomorrow morning?
Aisha: Yes. I’ll run numbers with Seth and send a shadow workbook. If we include a 'POC VPC premium' I’ll propose 20% uplift and an option to credit it toward the reserved commitment. Thoughts?
Seth: 20% seems reasonable as a starting point. We should include an SLA for latency/uptime during POC. Also flag cost for HSM integration if they insist on HSM.
Tom: From CS: Zenith has a hard deadline driven by an internal board review. If we don’t show an infra path + legal signoff by Friday they’ll pause. I can coordinate a call with their CTO for Wed afternoon if we have answers.
DeployBot: POC env status: dedicated-poc-zenith created at 1763752200, region: us-east-1, instance: Dedicated-1 (shared). No VPC peering configured.
Raj: I'll prepare the VPC template and a short runbook for the Zenith net team. Need Priya to confirm KMS/HSM requirements before I finalize IAM roles. ETA: 24 hours.
Priya: I’ll annotate the questionnaire with recommended language for 'no persistent PHI storage' and 'customer-managed keys' options. For HSM: we support KMS-managed keys; HSM would be an add-on (legal needs to approve).
Marcel: Action list: 1) Priya — annotated questionnaire + KMS/HSM options (today). 2) Raj — VPC template + runbook (tomorrow morning). 3) Aisha/Seth — price sketched + POC uplift and credit path (tomorrow AM). 4) Tom — coordinate call with Zenith CTO (Wed PM) if items done.
Aisha: I’ll also include recommended contract language re: data segregation and audit logs — keeps legal happy.
Seth: I'll size the dedicated GPUs and estimate token costs for their workload profile. Need their sample workload (tokens/sec) — Tom, can you push for that in the call?
Tom: I already flagged the ask in the last Zenith email thread. I’ll push for a sample trace on the call.
Marcel: We may need an exec note for CRO/CTO to approve a small concession (POC network premium credit). @Raj @Priya can you both DM me if anything needs escalation so I can take to CRO?
Raj: Will do.
Priya: If legal needs to see the customer's security officer, schedule the meeting — we’re ready to join.
Aisha: Quick Q — does the POC need SOC2 docs uploaded to their vendor portal or a signed attestation? Zenith asked both.
Priya: Send SOC2 + attestation. I’ll prepare a short cover note explaining scope.
Marcel: Great. Let's treat this as an internal exec escalation: tag me and Tom on any blocker threads. I’ll loop in CRO if we hit a policy cost that needs sign-off. :v:
Tom: On it. I’ll update Zenith after Raj/Priya share drafts.
Marcel: Thanks team — keep updates concise here. If we meet the timeline we have a strong chance to convert.
DeployBot: Reminder: weekly sales-eng sync scheduled Thu 09:00.
